quote.text: Não temos exatamente uma vida curta, mas desperdiçamos uma grande parte dela. A vida, se bem empregada, é suficientemente longa e nos foi dada com muita generosidade para a realização de importantes tarefas.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Devote time and presence to nurture your children; like Seneca suggests, investing in meaningful moments can yield a lifetime of growth and fulfillment.
    • Embrace every interaction with your child as an important task, cultivating habits and values that shape their future and honor the gift of time.
  • Leadership:
    • As a leader, recognize that time is a precious resource; steer your energy toward initiatives that enrich both your team and your own purpose.
    • Foster an environment where meaningful work is valued, ensuring that each task contributes to a larger, generative vision rather than being wasted in trivial pursuits.
  • Product Management:
    • Approach your projects with the mindset that every moment counts, prioritizing features and strategies that truly benefit users over fleeting trends.
    • Manage your product lifecycle by focusing on tasks that add lasting value, treating each milestone as a crucial step toward realizing a generous and impactful vision.
